summary: Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiaries DPS Holdings Inc. and Mott's LLP, with other affiliates, completed previously announced transactions with FHU US Holdings, LLC (Chobani) on September 28, 2026. The company redeemed all indirect equity interests in Chobani for $800 million aggregate consideration — $400 million cash plus a $400 million Chobani promissory note maturing December 26, 2026 — and sold certain assets, including leasehold interests in two Allentown, Pennsylvania facilities, for $125 million cash. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The short-dated note carries counterparty credit exposure; watch repayment by the December maturity and any related gain or loss disclosure.
